title: A little sky, stitched
alt: Hands stitch coloured appliqué shapes onto a teal textile, inspired by Pipili chandua.
story: A needle carries the sun across a piece of cloth. Nearby, a bird waits for its wing and a flower for its last small curve. Under the maker's hands, scraps find a sky together. What was separate becomes shelter: a bright, patient answer to the day's ordinary shade.
cultural_connection: Pipili is associated with chandua and appliqué. The image studies sewn shapes and raised cloth edges in an imagined work in progress.
status: Reserved for future use; no current edition assigned
